channel.description: Latest articles from Business Today India (businesstoday.in)

item.title: Vedanta shares rise 88% from 52-week low: What investors should know before placing their bets
item.description: Vedanta shares were trading 0.74% higher at Rs 681.15. Market cap of the firm stood at Rs 2.66 lakh crore.

item.title: Novo Nordisk eyes oral Wegovy as semaglutide generics loom
item.description: With injectable semaglutide set to face generic entry in India in March, Novo Nordisk indicates plans to expand its oral obesity portfolio while defending its premium positioning through brand, scale and advocacy

item.title: Himachal Pradesh revises toll tax rates. Here's how much vehicle entry fee you'll have to pay from April 1
item.description: These will apply primarily to out-of-state vehicles, including cars, vans, jeeps, buses, trucks, and earth-moving equipment, among others.

item.title: ‘No need to be disrespectful’: Macron tells Raj Shamani what he thinks of Trump making their private messages public
item.description: French President Macron told podcaster Raj Shamani that respect is part of leadership, and leaders must be respectful towards each other.

item.title: India’s AI future can’t be built on copy-paste regulation, says Google’s Sachin Kakkar
item.description: He pointed out that global regulation often ignores the real-world challenges for countries as unique as India, which consists of extreme linguistic diversity.

item.title: Sarvam AI can train competitive models for a fraction of Big Tech’s cost, co-founder Pratyush Kumar says
item.description: In an interview with Business Today, Sarvam's Pratyush Kumar said his startup has shown that advanced models can be developed with far fewer resources than previously assumed

item.title: IndusInd Bank shares: Emkay raises target price by 38%; a turnaround story loading?
item.description: Emkay Global has upgraded its rating on IndusInd Bank and has revised its target price by 38 per cent, citing its confidence in the new management of the private lender.

item.title: India AI Impact Summit: With no long queues, Swiggy delivers 2000+ orders in 2 days, turns summit into live food-tech demo
item.description: Instead of standing in long lines at food counters, attendees ordered from a curated list of top restaurants within Bharat Mandapam through the Swiggy app
